verdict.rationale: Claude Code exposes a documented Agent SDK for building custom agents with full orchestration/tool/permission control, an MCP server/client interface (including running itself as an MCP server), CI/CLI scripting support, and API key-based auth (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) — all documented publicly and confirmed via probe. This constitutes a genuine documented public API/SDK surface for agentic use, though it's less a traditional REST API and more CLI+SDK+MCP based.
